summary.text: Matthew Robert Mills (born November 14, 1996) is an American professional stock car racing driver. He last competed part-time in the NASCAR Craftsman Truck Series, driving the No. 4 Chevrolet Silverado RST for Niece Motorsports. He has also previously competed in the NASCAR Cup Series and NASCAR Xfinity Series.
